title: Residuated lattice
description: A finite residuated lattice (L, <=, *, e, \, /): a lattice (L, meet, join) carrying a monoid (*, e) whose fusion is residuated by a left residual \ and a right residual / satisfying the Lambek residuation law  a*b <= c  iff  b <= a\c  iff  a <= c/b. Presented finitely by its carrier, partial order (leq, given as covering/<= pairs and reflexive-transitively closed by the residuating morphism), monoid unit, and fusion table; the residual tables are derived and verified by the residuating morphism. This is the value-lattice floor of the predication fiber algebra: Lambek residuation lifts through the twist product to the bilattice's fusion/residual on A_p.

unit.description: The monoid unit e in carrier.

fusion.description: The monoid fusion: fusion[a][b] = a*b, a carrier element.

left-residual.description: Derived: left-residual[a][c] = a\c, the greatest x with a*x <= c.

right-residual.description: Derived: right-residual[b][c] = c/b, the greatest x with x*b <= c.
